propertySets.name: Pset_PumpOccurrence
propertySets.definition: Pump occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcPump.

properties.name: ImpellerDiameter
properties.definition: Diameter of object - used to scale performance of geometrically similar objects.

properties.name: BaseType
properties.definition:
Defines general types of pump bases.FRAME: Frame.
BASE: Base.
NONE: There is no pump base, such as an inline pump.
OTHER: Other type of pump base.

properties.name: DriveConnectionType
properties.definition:
The way the pump drive mechanism is connected to the pump.DIRECTDRIVE: Direct drive.
BELTDRIVE: Belt drive.
COUPLING: Coupling.
OTHER: Other type of drive connection.

properties.name: OverallEfficiency
properties.definition:
Total efficiency of object.

The pump and motor overall operational efficiency.

properties.name: PowerHistory
properties.definition: The actual power consumption of the pump.

propertySets.name: Pset_PumpTypeCommon
propertySets.definition: Common attributes of a pump type.

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: FlowRateRange
properties.definition: Allowable range of volume of fluid being pumped against the resistance specified.

properties.name: FlowResistanceRange
properties.definition: Allowable range of frictional resistance against which the fluid is being pumped.

properties.name: ConnectionSize
properties.definition:
The connection size of the object.

The connection to and from the pump.

properties.name: TemperatureRange
properties.definition:
Allowable maximum and minimum temperature.

Allowable operational range of the fluid temperature.

properties.name: NetPositiveSuctionHead
properties.definition: Minimum liquid pressure at the pump inlet to prevent cavitation.

properties.name: NominalRotationSpeed
properties.definition:
Rotational speed of the object under nominal conditions.

Pump rotational speed under nominal conditions.

propertySets.name: Qto_PumpBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all types of pumps.
